changelog: Migrated FCM notification delivery from registration tokens to Firebase Installation IDs (FID).
Added acknowledged FID registration, retry handling and updated backend device registration.
Redesigned follow-up sync with session-aware, city-specific and event-driven workflows.
Applied visit schedule, cancelled-visit and Special Day Mode eligibility rules to follow-up synchronization.
Prevented queued sync work from executing under a different login session.
Improved APK verification and installation using Android PackageInstaller with installation status handling.
Improved notification WebView measurement and layout handling.
